concerns.text: Spec edge case requires fast‑failure with a clear error message when the QM9‑IR dataset is corrupted or incomplete. Task T103 only verifies successful download and alignment; it does not assert that corrupted/incomplete data aborts the pipeline, thus the acceptance criterion from the spec is missing.

Spec edge case mandates filtering out any molecule missing any of the three target MolecularProperties before training. Task T104’s description (preprocess spectra) does not mention this filtering step nor a verification artifact confirming that no rows with missing targets remain.

Spec edge case states that if the training loss diverges or becomes NaN, the training loop must detect it, stop immediately, and log a "Training Failed" status. Task T105’s verification only checks checkpoint existence, epoch count, and early‑stopping behavior; it does not verify NaN‑loss detection, so the requirement is omitted.
